translation: The 《Sun Zhenren Weisheng Ge》 (Song of Health by the Perfected Sun): If you wish not to die, cultivate Kunlun; with both hands rub and wipe constantly on the face. The words of the 《Ting Jing》: Kunlun is a mountain name, the highest position in the northwest, used as a metaphor for the head. The next line is the Perfected One practicing it in body and deed, having obtained the essential formula and speaking of it.
